decision: Keep latest 144-profile API unchanged as default; relocate 204-profile modules byte-for-byte to bie.audio.compat204. Both profiles feed one source-bound SpeechPlan and the same VO-006..010 provider/cache pipeline.
prohibited: No automatic parser fallback, no guessed API equivalence, no deletion/recreation of original ZIP bytes, no task-ID renumbering.

differences.profile204: bounded sums/products, all 24 Greek names, English-scoped parser; explicit preserved API
differences.profile144: documented English/Hindi parser and reading API; no automatic sum/product fallback

differences.profile204: source-block segmentation and review issues retained; no invented pauses
differences.profile144: canonical SpeechUtterance input and explicit source-bound Pause records

differences.profile204: versioned role/domain lexicon and named pronunciation APIs
differences.profile144: separate lexicon/symbol/acronym tables, IPA metadata, PLS export

original_archives_location: lineage/audio_batch001; not on production import path
open_note: These are two explicit compatibility APIs, not proof their algorithms are semantically identical. Original test assertions are unchanged; relocated 204 tests only change imports/CLI module names.
